title: School
description: What one institution in a country profile (data/countries/) offers an IB student, researched from its own pages: a one-line summary, its English-taught bachelor's degrees with a link to each programme's own page, what it asks of IB applicants, and its dates for the next autumn intake. Where nearly every course is taught in English (a UK or US university), the programmes are not listed and the hand-off is the course search. One file per institution, data/schools/<key>.json, where <key> is the institution key the site derives: <country code>-<slug of shortName or name>. See docs/research/schools/BRIEF.md.

institution.description: The institution key, e.g. fi-uh. Must match an institution in data/countries/.

name.description: The institution's name, for a human reading the file.

intake.description: The intake the programmes and dates are for, normally 2027-autumn.

scope.description: listed: every English-taught bachelor's degree open to first-year applicants for the intake is in `programmes`. catalogue: nearly all courses are taught in English, too many to list; `programmes` is empty and `handoff` is the course search. none: no English-taught bachelor's degree for the intake; `programmes` is empty.

summary.description: One line a 17-year-old would read: what the place is and why an IB student might look. Not a slogan, not a ranking claim unless sourced.

handoff.description: The one targeted page the site sends a student on to: the list of English-taught bachelor's degrees, the undergraduate course search, or the page for international or IB applicants. Never the homepage.

label.description: What the page is, e.g. 'English-taught bachelor's degrees' or 'Undergraduate course search'.

ib.description: What the institution asks of IB Diploma applicants in general: minimum points, subjects, English. From its own page.

starts.description: When the first year starts, as the record's sources say it ('October', 'Late August or early September'). A programme's own `starts` overrides it. Absent: the page says 'Autumn <year>', never a guessed month.

noDeadline.description: The school sets no application deadline for an EU/EEA applicant: what its record says instead ('Apply up to the start of the semester'). The Apply-by tile reads 'No deadline' with this as its note.

ownDeadline.description: The route's general closing date is not this deadline: it runs its own selection, test registration or audition (WU's BBE selection, a university's entrance-test degrees, a ballet audition). Its page never takes the route's date as Apply by, and says 'Not published yet' until its own date is recorded.

lastYear.description: Last year's date, where this year's is not published yet: the page's Apply-by reads 'Not published yet' with it as the note ('2026: register by 19 May'). Only what the record's sources say.

text.description: The date in a few words, without the year: '15 April', 'register 2 March–19 May; exam 30 June'.

apply.description: Where the application is made, when it is not the institution's own portal alone (e.g. Studyinfo.fi, UCAS, Universityadmissions.se).

dates.description: Dates for the intake that apply to the whole institution. A date that belongs to one programme goes on that programme.

courses.description: For scope catalogue: how many undergraduate courses it offers, as its own course listing counts them.

language.description: For scope none: the language its bachelor's degrees are taught in, e.g. 'Swedish'. The page is titled 'Taught in <language>'.

notes.description: At most three things worth knowing that a student would not guess, one sentence each.

kind.description: What happens on the day. 'closes' is an application deadline, the only kind a programme page gives as 'Apply by'; where several are the reader's, the first. 'early' is an earlier chance you can still apply after: Early Action, an early bird, a priority date, a discount, an earlier round. 'housing' is a date to apply for housing (a housing lottery, a residence's own deadline). Neither is ever the deadline: the nearest shows as the Apply-by tile's note.

short.description: The date's name in a few words, for a fact tile's note: 'Early Action', '€2,000 off', 'Round 1'. Read on an 'early' date.

supersedes.description: "<routeId>/<milestoneId>" of a route date this one replaces on this institution's page, e.g. an institution that runs its own application window instead of the national one. See the same field on an Application Route milestone.

provisional.description: True when the record does not confirm the date for this school's 2027 programmes: a national round the school has not yet said which programmes run in ('if a programme runs it'). A programme page gives it as 'Apply by' with the note 'Not yet confirmed for 2027', and the dates panel marks it provisional. scripts/check-schools.mjs requires it on every date of a round whose label says so.

programmes.description: Only for these programmes, by the slug of their page (/universities/<key>/<slug>/): a round only some programmes run in. The date shows on those programmes' pages and on the school's, and on no other programme's page. scripts/check-schools.mjs checks each slug names a programme of the record.

name.description: The programme's English name as the institution writes it.

credential.description: A standard abbreviation a student knows (BSc, BA, BBA, BEng, LLB, BMus), else the degree's full English title ('Bachelor of Health Care'). Never an invented abbreviation.

city.description: Only when it differs from the institution's city.

url.description: The programme's own page on the institution's site. Never the homepage or a generic list.

ib.description: What this programme asks of IB applicants beyond the institution's general rule: subjects and levels, points, an entrance exam.

tuitionEuEea.description: Per year for EU/EEA citizens, e.g. 'Free', '€1,500 a year'.

closes.description: The application deadline for this programme, when it differs from the institution's.

round.description: The one admission round this programme runs in, when the school's dates name several ('January round', 'April round'): the words its dates' labels begin with. Its page then shows the school's dates of that round only, with this programme's `closesForDiplomaHolders` in place of the round's own flag, and none of the route's general dates.

closesForDiplomaHolders.description: True when `closes` is a deadline only for applicants who already hold their IB Diploma (a programme that runs only in such a round). Its page lists the date but never shows it as 'Apply by', and its card says 'Diploma holders only'. See common.schema.json forDiplomaHolders.

code.description: The code you name the programme by when you apply (a CAO code such as AD211), when the application asks for one. Shown beside 'Apply via' on its page, never in `about`.

about.description: What the degree is, in one or two plain sentences from the programme's own page: what you study and what makes it different from its neighbours. The 'What it is' block of the programme's page. No slogans, no rankings.

needs.description: The subjects this programme requires, in IB terms, one entry per requirement. Every subject the institution names, with the strictest reading where a table converts local levels (never 'prefers' where it requires). Empty or absent when none are required beyond the Diploma.

anyOf.description: Acceptable IB subjects by id in data/ib-subjects.json (e.g. ["mathematics-aa", "mathematics-ai"]). Any one of them satisfies this requirement. An option accepted only at one level carries it after the id, "<id>@HL" or "<id>@SL", and that overrides `level` for that option alone: AA at SL or HL, or AI only at HL, is {"anyOf": ["mathematics-aa", "mathematics-ai@HL"], "level": "SL"}, shown as "Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL". The level must be one the subject is offered at.

level.description: The lowest level accepted: HL means HL only; SL means SL or HL; any means the level is not specified.

grade.description: Minimum IB grade, when one is stated or converted from a published table.

note.description: A condition the fields cannot hold, e.g. 'grade 5 at SL is also accepted'.

points.description: Minimum IB Diploma points the programme states (or the institution states for it).

selection.description: How places are decided, in order of weight. grades: ranked on IB results; entrance-exam: the institution's or a national exam; assignment: a pre-assignment or task; motivation: letter or CV scored; test-score: SAT/ACT/uniTEST-type; first-come: rolling until full; lottery: drawn; open: everyone eligible is admitted.

selectionNote.description: One line on how the selection works, in the student's terms.

cutoff.description: The last admitted applicant's score, only where the institution or national portal publishes it. Never estimated.

value.description: As published, e.g. '34 IB points', '8.9 (Swedish BI scale)'.

ibPoints.description: The same cut-off in IB points, only when an official table converts it.

places.description: Study places for the 2027 intake (or the latest published), when stated.

routePlaces.description: Of `places`, the ones in the route this site's reader applies through (an EU/EEA student in their final IB year), when the source splits them, e.g. 35 of 50 in international rolling admission. Shown as '35 of 50 places in your route'.

family.description: One programme offered on several campuses, or as several paths (a double degree, a longer version with an internship), is one card with its paths inside (issues #46 and #52). Every member carries the same `name` and `axis`; the members of a family are the programmes of this record that share `name`. Checked by src/lib/families.mjs checkSchoolFamilies.

name.description: The card's title, the same on every member.

path.description: This path's short label: its campus, or what makes it different ('LUT + HEBUT double degree').

differs.description: One line: what is different about this path, from the record's own fields.

cardLine.description: Optional short form of `differs` for this path's row on the card. Required where no recorded fact tells the paths apart on the card.

primary.description: Exactly one member is the card's link.

separateFrom.description: A deliberate 'these look alike but are two cards': another programme of this record with the same subject name, and why it stays a card of its own (what a student must do differs).

ownDeadline.description: The route's general closing date is not this deadline: it runs its own selection, test registration or audition (WU's BBE selection, a university's entrance-test degrees, a ballet audition). Its page never takes the route's date as Apply by, and says 'Not published yet' until its own date is recorded.

lastYear.description: Last year's date, where this year's is not published yet: the page's Apply-by reads 'Not published yet' with it as the note ('2026: register by 19 May'). Only what the record's sources say.

text.description: The date in a few words, without the year: '15 April', 'register 2 March–19 May; exam 30 June'.

requirementsUrl.description: The page that states this programme's entry requirements, when it is not `url`.
